cases.title: Remarks after a loss
cases.where: Bruca Beach Hammerheads at San Saltadac Sea Lions, week 6
cases.text:
Belen Herrblanca (DL, Sea Lions) told reporters after the game that the officiating crew had 'decided the outcome'.

He has 1 earlier case on the desk in the last three seasons. Most recent: Scuffle that emptied the benches (2044, week 12): Fine $15K. The players' union says it is reviewing the remarks.

cases.title: Sideline conduct
cases.where: Verigon Komodos at Classetto Cavemen, week 6
cases.text:
Yaritza Navaclara, head coach of the Cavemen, was flagged for sideline conduct after a heated exchange with Isidro Valmont.

The Cavemen say they will not comment further.
